final: WITH j AS (SELECT s.riskeval AS status, m.facetfaces AS faces FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref), g AS (SELECT status, SUM(faces) AS total_faces, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY status), a AS (SELECT AVG(total_faces) AS avg_total FROM g) SELECT SUM(g.total_faces) AS total_of_sums, AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_record_count, AVG(g.total_faces - a.avg_total) AS avg_difference FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.total_faces > a.avg_total
